name: The radio
description: Teeter's radio hums on its shelf, tuned to something illegal and wonderful.

name: A tea corner
description: A kettle, three mismatched mugs, and a chair nobody admits is theirs.

name: Perrin's workbench
description: Doc Perrin's tools, laid out by size, and a stuffed pigeon supervising.

name: A row of cots
description: Real cots, made up, because somebody finally stopped sleeping on the floor.

name: A stocked shelf
description: Wren's stores: a few clockwork noise-makers and not much else.

name: A tool rack
description: Wire cutters on hooks, each labelled with the name of whoever last lost them.

name: Warm lamps
description: Someone found bulbs that are not the city's colour. The room looks like a place people live.

name: A tomato box
description: A box of earth by the lamp, with one very serious seedling in it.
